payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: April, Jung, Kelle, Linnea, Nickole, Tawna

payload.content: Planning: I’m Linnea (4.0h; strongest security). I can take one task. Prefer low-effort security triage/review/docs; avoid heavy security implement/test. I will likely claim ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0002::review/test if others take security items.

Request: if you’re taking ISSUE-0001::triage/review/docs/security implement, tell the group so I avoid duplicates. I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 2.8) as it fits best with my 4h limit and low cost vs other security items.

Planning update (Tawna): I’m considering frontend tasks for ISSUE-0002 since my strongest skill is frontend and I want to avoid overlapping with Linnea’s likely security triage. No claim yet—please coordinate.

Tawna (planning): Available 10h. My viable low-effort frontend options: ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, cost 1.23) or ISSUE-0002::test (effort 1.4, cost 1.72) or ::implement (effort 2.0, cost 2.45). If someone else takes all ISSUE-0002 frontend items, I’ll skip or take remaining security-light items only if not duplicated.

April (planning): I’m strongest in security (0.95) and also frontend (0.83). Available 10h, prefer low-effort security items. I’m leaning to take ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 2.8, low) if nobody else claims it; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0001::review (effort 3.5) or a frontend low-effort task in ISSUE-0002. Please coordinate to avoid duplicates.

April planning note: if ISSUE-0001::triage is claimed by Linnea, I will likely pick the next cheapest feasible low-effort item for security/front-end that avoids overlap (e.g., ISSUE-0002::review or ISSUE-0002::test).

Planning (Kelle): my top skill is security (0.71) but costs make heavy security implement/test expensive for me. I can take ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 2.8, cost 3.45) or ISSUE-0001::review/docs/test if needed. I’m going to avoid duplicates with Linnea’s likely triage; if triage is taken I prefer ISSUE-0001::review (lowest remaining cost) over test/docs/implement and avoid ISSUE-0002::implement (too costly for me). Confirm if ISSUE-0001::triage is free.
If nobody claims any ISSUE-0001 security items, I’ll take ISSUE-0001::triage; otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0001::review (cost 4.31) as next-best. I’ll skip ISSUE-0002 tasks unless they remain unclaimed.

Jung planning (avail 5h; best skills frontend>security). I can take low-effort frontend tasks: ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, cost 1.03) or ISSUE-0002::test (1.4, cost 1.45) or implement (2.0, cost 2.06). For security-heavy ISSUE-0001 implement/test/docs/triage, my costs are higher; I prefer frontend review/test to avoid contention. Please confirm whether ISSUE-0002 frontend items are already targeted by others to prevent duplicates.

Nickole planning: with 6h and strong frontend skill, I’m inclined to take a low-effort ISSUE-0002 frontend task. My cheapest feasible for me is ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, cost 1.10). I will avoid ISSUE-0001 security-heavy items due to very high cost for me.
To avoid duplicates: if someone already plans ISSUE-0002::review, I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test. Otherwise I’ll aim for ISSUE-0002::review in execution.

Linnea planning sync: I’m favoring ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 2.8, low) as my claim candidate; please avoid selecting it if you were considering it. If it’s taken, my next-best (lower cost/feasible) would be ISSUE-0002::review or ::test (frontend).

Tawna planning: I will likely claim ISSUE-0002::test (effort 1.4) or ::implement (2.0) depending on whether others take ::review. I understand Linnea prefers ISSUE-0001::triage, so I’ll avoid security items to prevent duplicates. Can someone confirm if ISSUE-0002::review is already targeted (Nickole/Jung) so I can choose a non-duplicate frontend task?
Tawna note: my best-match low-cost frontend tasks are ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.23), ::test (1.72), ::implement (2.45). If ISSUE-0002::review is taken, I can switch to ::test.

April planning sync: I will avoid duplicating ISSUE-0001::triage since Linnea is favoring it. My likely execution pick is ISSUE-0002::review (frontend) if unclaimed; otherwise next would be ISSUE-0002::test. I’m communicating to prevent duplicates.

Planning sync update (Kelle): I’m ready to claim ISSUE-0001::review if ISSUE-0001::triage ends up taken by Linnea. Otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0001::triage. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 to prevent duplicates with frontend-focused agents unless all ISSUE-0002 items remain unclaimed.

Jung planning update: to avoid duplicates with Nickole/A–April/Tawna, I am leaning to claim ISSUE-0002::test only if ISSUE-0002::review is taken; otherwise I’d take ISSUE-0002::review (lowest effort/cost). Please let me know your intended choice for ISSUE-0002::review.
Also, I will avoid ISSUE-0001 security-heavy tasks due to high costs for me; if any security micro-task remains unclaimed, coordinate before I consider it.

Planning update from Nickole: I intend to take ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, low priority). To avoid duplicates, please do not also claim ISSUE-0002::review; if already taken, I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test.

Linnea planning: I will execute-claim ISSUE-0001::triage (security) unless someone else beats me to it in this round. Please avoid selecting ISSUE-0001::triage to prevent duplicates; I’m ok with ISSUE-0002::review/test only if triage is taken.

Planning sync (Tawna): I will avoid ISSUE-0001 security items since Linnea is targeting ISSUE-0001::triage and April/Kelle coordinating. For ISSUE-0002, since Nickole/Jung both say they want ISSUE-0002::review, I will plan to take ISSUE-0002::test in execution to avoid duplicates; if ::test is taken unexpectedly, I will skip.

April planning: I will avoid ISSUE-0001::triage (Linnea likely takes) to prevent duplicates. If ISSUE-0002::review is unclaimed by Nickole/Jung, I’ll take ISSUE-0002::review; otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0002::test if unclaimed. Otherwise skip.

Kelle planning sync: Based on Linnea likely taking ISSUE-0001::triage and Nickole/Jung likely taking ISSUE-0002::review, I will in execution avoid duplicates. If triage is taken, I’ll take ISSUE-0001::review (lowest remaining security cost for me). If triage unexpectedly unclaimed, I’ll take ISSUE-0001::triage. For ISSUE-0002 tasks, I will skip to avoid contention unless all security items are taken and frontend ones are unclaimed.

Jung (planning): I’ve heard Nickole intends ISSUE-0002::review. To avoid duplicate, my likely execution pick will be ISSUE-0002::test (if ::review is taken) otherwise I’d take ::review. I will skip all ISSUE-0001 security-heavy tasks since Linnea targets triage and costs are high for me.

Planning sync: Nickole will claim ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, frontend) to avoid duplicates; if taken, I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test. I will not take any ISSUE-0001 security tasks due to high cost.

Linnea planning update: I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::triage in execution (effort 2.8, cost 2.60; within 4h). I will not claim ISSUE-0002 frontend items to avoid duplicate with Nickole/Jung/Tawna. Please refrain from selecting ISSUE-0001::triage.

Planning sync (Tawna): I will take ISSUE-0002::test in execution if it’s unclaimed; since Nickole/Jung plan ISSUE-0002::review, I’ll avoid duplicates by not claiming ::review. I’m skipping ISSUE-0001 security items because Linnea targets ISSUE-0001::triage.
April planning coordination: I will avoid ISSUE-0001::triage (Linnea) and aim for ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0002::test if unclaimed. If both taken, I’ll skip.

Kelle planning update: I will avoid duplicates with Linnea's intended ISSUE-0001::triage and Nickole/Jung's intended ISSUE-0002::review. My execution fallback is ISSUE-0001::review (cost 4.31) if triage is taken; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0001::triage. I will skip ISSUE-0002 tasks unless all remaining frontend items are unclaimed.

Jung planning: I will avoid ISSUE-0001 security-heavy tasks (my costs high). For ISSUE-0002, I’m aligned to take ISSUE-0002::test only if ISSUE-0002::review ends up unclaimed; otherwise I’ll skip to avoid duplicates with Nickole (review) / Tawna (test).

Planning sync: I (Nickole) will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution if unclaimed; I won’t take any ISSUE-0001 security tasks due to high private cost. If ::review is taken, my fallback is ISSUE-0002::test (but only if unclaimed).
